selection: first eligible min-hand-pips-discovery position with prior next-opponent empty-stock pass, >=3 canonical ordinary singles, <=6 hidden opponent stones, >=6 exact history-compatible allocations; first 30 qualifying independent seeds
confidence: Exploratory position-level normal 95% intervals, NOT adjusted for selection/multiple comparisons; independently selected deal seeds, within-position train/holdout hidden allocations.
limitations: Uniform exact hidden allocations conditional only on observed next-opponent passes; first-eligible late-game selection; small hidden-world train/test; canonical singles exclude alternative sides/doubles; assumed branch opening; fixed deterministic bot continuations; block winner unassigned; not proof of human-play causality.
newFinding: See independent and pooled position-level CI; do not claim a general advantage if confidence intervals include zero.
next: Preregister a larger independent cohort with >=12 compatible hidden allocations, evaluate non-zero pass-spread and same-geometry strata; test winner-target utility and remaining pips on held-out worlds.
